escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, The Best Magic Tricks You Will EVER See 🤯, by Wian, with over 10 million views.
In second place, Funniest Fan Chants in Football 😂 Bruno "Rat" Chant, by EltelwanyTV, with over 11 million views.
And number one: Por favor comparte con tus amigos, by Mohamed Gamal, with over 66 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
